title: Worker factory hardening
summary: The worker factory is durable, dependency-ready, and bounded for the first G2 cycle.
evidence: The Ubuntu merged-/usr Bubblewrap patch and regression test are preserved with SHA-256 receipts.
The sandbox suite passed 10 tests with 5 platform skips and zero failures.
Build task budgets were raised from 18 to 40 turns with 20-minute timeouts.
Each worktree received a root-owned non-writable dependency tree matching the locked package file.
Six new workers match the six independent packages, while all kickoff issues remain gated and workers idle.
No network package installation, production access, deployment, GitHub push, or metered Anthropic API use occurred.
limitations: The independent Claude G1 review and final cross-lane containment receipt must pass before any build starts.
